siteDescription: Inveh Lighting Solutions provides interior lighting, hotel lighting, custom nameboards, and handcrafted wooden lamps for homes, hotels, and interior decorators across Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
socialDescription: Interior lighting, hotel lighting, custom nameboards and handcrafted wooden lamps for homes, businesses and decorators across Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
serviceParagraphs: We create practical and distinctive lighting for homes, hotels, restaurants, offices and retail spaces. Our interior lighting services include handcrafted wooden pendant lamps, wall sconces, tube lights, table lamps and custom lighting concepts for new interiors and renovation projects.

Inveh also works with interior decorators, architects, builders and hospitality teams on hotel lighting, restaurant lighting, personalised nameboards and custom wooden signage. Based in Udumalpet, Tamil Nadu, we serve customers and project partners across Tamil Nadu and Kerala.
